reply.markdown: Reply in Markdown. For each question you want to update, write one block:
reply.placeholder: <the final answer, in the same language I used>
reply.reasonPlaceholder: <why this amount, in the same language I used>
reply.exactIds: Use the exact IDs in square brackets.
reply.onlyUpdated: Only include questions you are updating.
reply.noTranslation: Do not translate my answers. Do not add F/A/U labels.
reply.amounts: For amount questions ({{keys}}), use "### {{amount}}" and "### {{reason}}" under the heading.
reply.json: Reply in JSON in the form of example: one item in answers for each question you want to update, with its exact id and the final answer as text, in the same language I used. Only include questions you are updating. Do not translate my answers. Do not add F/A/U labels.
reply.jsonAmounts: For amount questions ({{keys}}), give amount as a number and reason instead of text.
